//: Runtime rails for agent deploys (SPEC.md constitution rule 6, rewritten 2026-09-30: agents may deploy under rails). Deploys and root SSH are allowed; configuration changes are canary-first with before/after evidence; destructive or irreversible actions prompt for explicit operator authorisation per action; force-pushes stay denied. Rules are glob patterns over the full command string; opencode evaluates the LAST matching rule, so the prompts and denies at the bottom deliberately win over the allows above them. NOTE: takes effect on the next opencode restart.
